redesign.title: AI dashboard
redesign.subtitle: From AI usage to delivered code, see every contribution clearly.
redesign.dailyTrend: Daily trend · table grouping does not change the chart
redesign.simulationHint: Test data only · not a production report

codeReport.title: Code generation and submission
codeReport.tableHint: Generated lines count SQL in assistant replies only · All matching results
codeReport.generatedHint: Nightly scan of SQL in assistant replies, independent of Hooks
codeReport.submittedHint: Synthetic added lines · Live submission tables not connected
codeReport.fixtureOnly: SQL from fixture Hook records · Submissions are synthetic
codeReport.realGeneratedHint: Session SQL scanned nightly, then projected from original report rows
codeReport.realSubmittedHint: MR additions with status=merged, dated by merged_at in Shanghai; deduplicated by submission record, not commit
codeReport.unknownValues: Some records have no valid line count. Totals include known values only; all-unknown results show —.

integrationNotReady: Integration detail has not been generated for this batch. Wait for the next idle refresh; no old-table or synthetic fallback is used.
splitNotReady: The five topic tables are not ready for this batch. Complete migration or wait for the idle refresh; no wide-table, old-report or synthetic fallback is used.
splitGeneratedHint: SQL generation detail · Sum of generated_sql_lines from assistant SQL replies
exportCurrentHint: Download an Excel-compatible CSV of all results with the applied filters, grouping and sort, not just this page.
exportFailed: Export failed. No file was created. Please retry.
exportChanged: The results changed. No file was created. Refresh and retry.
exportTooLarge: The workbook exceeds 50,000 rows or 10 MB. Narrow the filters and try again.
summaryHint: Fixed metrics · Independent of filters and grouping below
summaryPeriodHint: The 30-day window ends on the data cutoff date; single-day figures refer to that date.
tenantReportDenied: Your account does not have permission to view tenant-wide reports. Contact your tenant administrator.
summaryPublicationHint: Successfully published through {{date}}, deduplicated by Skill ID; repeat publications count once
summaryFailed: The overall summary could not load. Use Refresh results to retry; details below remain independent.
summaryUnavailable: This service does not support the new overall summary yet. Open the updated preview or update the backend.
executionRecordsHint: Execution metadata only: no inputs, script output or logs. Unfinished duration is unavailable; status is from the nightly snapshot.
hookExecutionHint: Execution counts, success/failure and mean duration of completed executions. Unfinished status is not real-time. Business fields are available separately under Recording Hooks.
refreshConfirmMessage: Refreshing queries the published reports again and consumes database resources. It does not scan raw messages or start the nightly job early. Today's unpublished data remains unavailable. Continue?
skillsHint: Group by Skill or publisher. New publications count distinct Skills first published in the selected period. Calls include native Skill tools and /Skill commands in that period and belong to the publisher. Previously published Skills with zero calls remain visible. Callers are deduplicated across Skills. Unknown publication dates show —; calls with unconfirmed publishers are not credited to any user.
skillGroupingUnavailable: Publisher statistics require an updated report service.
sharedFiltersHint: Each tab saves its own date, user and workspace filters. The user filter on Skills selects publishers.
tableFiltersHint: This table only; shared filters stay unchanged
templateTableHint: Shows only active users and conversations from valid interactions associated with each template, deduplicated by actual user and logical conversation respectively. Filter names, sort and paginate. Explore one template by user, workspace or time. Totals include all matching results.
templateExploreHint: Shows only this template's active users and conversations, intersected with the outer date, user and workspace filters. Per-user rows omit the redundant 0/1 user count while retaining the deduplicated total. Workspace and time views show both metrics. Totals cover all matching results, not just this page.
skillPublisherHint: Published Skill counts and Skill call counts belong to the publishing user; conversations and active duration belong to the actual user. Publication counts deduplicate Skill IDs first published within the selected dates; call counts also include calls to Skills published earlier.
hookFieldsHint: Available number fields are listed here. Open Record details to filter by user, workspace and date, then view sum, average, minimum or maximum, optionally grouped by user.
hookDirectoryHint: One row per Hook with records in this range. Enter a Hook to filter its numeric fields and group by user, workspace or time.
singleHookHint: Filter records, then choose a grouping, numeric field and aggregation.
hookReportFilterHint: Apply updates both statistics and records. Filters initially inherit the list; reset restores those opening filters. Dashboard cards are unaffected.
hookNumericHint: Only valid numbers participate. Averages use every valid record, not page or daily averages. Identical field definitions are combined across versions; actions, record types and sources remain separate. Results display numbers only, without unit suffixes. Switching aggregations does not trigger nightly recomputation.
noNumericResults: No numeric fields match these filters. Adjust the filters and try again.
hookRecordsHint: {{count}} matching records. Selecting a numeric field includes only records with a valid value for that field. Statistics cover all matching records, regardless of pagination.
detailRecordFiltersHint: These filters apply to both the statistics above and the records below. Statistics cover all matching records, regardless of pagination. Choose By user for each user's field statistics. Reset restores the opening filters without changing the outer report.
hookNumbersUnavailable: This service does not yet support all four statistics for every number field. Update the report service and retry.
hookUserGroupingUnavailable: This report service does not support field statistics by user yet. Open the updated preview or update the backend.
activityHint: DAU: users with interactions on {{date}}. MAU: distinct users from {{from}} through {{date}}. Both are generated overnight, not live activity today.
activityPending: Activity metrics are not included in this batch. They will appear after the next overnight run.
operationsHint: Click a column to sort all matching published results, not only this page
analysisHint: Group before filtering metrics. Users and conversations are deduplicated; totals cover all matching groups, not a sum of this page. All results use the overnight published snapshot.
unifiedTableHint: Grouping changes update immediately. Sort with column headers or browse pages. Totals cover all filtered results.
usageTableHint: By entity compares users or workspaces; By time summarizes days, weeks or months. User rows retain zero-use members but omit the redundant 0/1 active-user column. The summary still deduplicates all matching users. Date filters set the scope; table view, sorting and pagination do not change the daily chart above.
usageGroupingUnavailable: This report service does not yet support the unified table with zero-usage users. Update the report service and retry.

grouping.dayHint: Daily totals within the selected dates
grouping.weekHint: Monday–Sunday · First/last weeks use selected dates only
grouping.monthHint: Monthly totals · First/last months use selected dates only

invalidMetricRange: Enter non-negative values. The minimum cannot exceed the maximum.

hookReportFields.title: AI report fields (optional)
hookReportFields.warning: Selected fields become visible to users with report access in this tenant. Do not select conversation text, prompts, secrets, credentials or other sensitive information. No fields are exposed by default.
hookReportFields.versionHint: Select up to 20 existing flat record fields. Exposed number fields automatically calculate sum, average, minimum and maximum. Choose which to view in the report, not in this configuration. Published versions retain their field definitions. Deleted or renamed fields must be selected again.
hookReportFields.invalidKey: Use a plain field name containing letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens. Nested paths and expressions are not supported.
hookReportFields.label: Display name

applicationActorHint: Users here are the people who applied templates. Application snapshots do not imply actual conversations.
sessionActorHint: Users here are actual conversation users, not necessarily the template applicant or workspace owner.
providerHint: Provider filters affect conversations, duration and Skill calls. Published Skills are not provider-specific.
title: AI usage reports
subtitle: Understand AI collaboration and shared contributions
exportUnconfigured: Export fields and format have not been configured. Downloads are not available yet. Exports will run asynchronously without rescanning messages.
exportSnapshot: Exports use this published batch. Permissions are rechecked during generation and download.
noBatchHint: Results appear after the first batch completes. Today's statistics are not available. Refreshing does not trigger computation.
todayHint: Only published dates are available. Today's data will appear after a later off-hours batch completes.
staleHint: Statistics are incomplete or delayed. The latest published results remain visible.
partialHint: Some sources are missing or requests are still in progress. Unknown values appear as —, not zero. Completed requests will contribute their cross-day duration in a later batch.
durationHint: Sum of each request start → AI response completion. Excludes gaps between turns. Split across reporting dates, with no per-turn duration cap.
hookHint: Counts persisted business records, not Hook executions. Hooks, post-actions and record types remain distinct.
templateHint: Applications come from template snapshots. Associated conversations belong to actual users and are not application counts.
templatePending: Associated conversation details are not connected yet. Application counts do not substitute for conversation usage.
requestFailed: Unable to load reports. Please try again.
accessChanged: Report access changed. Previous data was cleared and permissions were rechecked.
batchMismatch: Report batches do not match. Refresh results and retry.
range.order: Start date must not follow end date.
range.unpublished: These dates have not been published yet. Select an available date range.
fieldsPending: No configured field statistics are available. Raw messages and full Hook JSON are not displayed.

workbook.hint: Each sheet shows its applied filters and totals above a separate detail section. Export all matching rows with each report’s applied grouping and sort, including daily trends and viewed Hook and template statistics.
